title: Yami language
description: Austronesian language spoken on Orchid Island, Taiwan
extract: The Yami language, also known as Tao, is a Malayo-Polynesian and Philippine language spoken by the Tao people of Orchid Island, 46 kilometers southeast of Taiwan. It is a member of the Ivatan dialect continuum.
